I help organisations work with data — from analysis and modelling to visualisation and reporting. My background is in physics; I now work mostly with clients in the non-profit, research, and public sector.

---

## Services

**Data analysis & modelling**
Exploratory analysis, statistical modelling, and reproducible research pipelines.

**Visualisation & reporting**
Clear, honest charts and reports that communicate findings to non-technical audiences.

**Open data & sustainability**
Projects that use publicly available data to shed light on inequality, ecology, or climate.
